{"script":"# Step 1 & 2
mkdir -p temp_var_count
id > temp_var_count/context.txt
umask >> temp_var_count/context.txt

# Step 3: Raw listing
find /var -printf "%p %y %l\n" > temp_var_count/var_listing.raw 2>/dev/null

# Step 4: Resolved listing
# Resolve symlinks. We'll use readlink -f on the path.
awk '{print $1}' temp_var_count/var_listing.raw | xargs -r readlink -f > temp_var_count/var_listing.resolved

# Step 5: Filter for regular files
# We need to check if the resolved path is a regular file.
while read p; do
    if [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -d "$p" ]; then
        echo "$p"
    fi
done < temp_var_count/var_listing.resolved | sort -u > temp_var_count/regular_files.list

# Step 6: Metadata
# inode, size, mtime
while read p; do
    stat -c "%i %s %Y" "$p"
done < temp_var_count/regular_files.list > temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv

# Step 7: Duplicates (same inode)
# Note: we should group the paths by inode.
sort temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv | awk '{print $1}' | uniq -d > temp_var_count/duplicate_inodes.txt
# Create duplicates.tsv
while read inode; do
    grep "^$inode " temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv | awk -v inod="$inode" '{print inod, $0}' # This is a bit messy, let's simplify
done < temp_var_count/duplicate_inodes.txt > temp_var_count/duplicates.tsv
# Actually, the requirement says "note whether each group should be treated as separate entries or a single object for counting"
# For counting unique files, unique inodes are usually preferred.

# Step 8: Alt listing and diff
find /var -printf "%p %y %l\n" > temp_var_count/var_listing.alt 2>/dev/null
diff temp_var_count/var_listing.raw temp_var_count/var_listing.alt > temp_var_count/consistency_diff.txt || true

# Step 9: Summary
RAW_COUNT=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/var_listing.raw)
REG_COUNT=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/regular_files.list)
UNIQUE_INODES=$(awk '{print $1}' temp_var_count/file_metadata.tsv | sort -u | wc -l)
DIFF_COUNT=$(wc -l < temp_var_count/consistency_diff.txt)
echo "Raw: $RAW_COUNT, Regular: $REG_COUNT, Unique Inodes: $UNIQUE_INODES, Diff: $DIFF_COUNT" > temp_var_count/summary_prep.txt

# Step 10: Checksums
sha256sum temp_var_count/* > temp_var_count/artifact_checksums.txt 2>/dev/null

# Get the final count of regular files
wc -l < temp_var_count/regular_files.list
"}
